author: Zetetic I
title: Scaling Up: Deeper Transformer with Increased Capacity
abstract: Following the successful validation of a Transformer with positional encodings (ID 603), this experiment investigates the impact of scaling. The baseline Transformer, while strong on some datasets, was weak on others. This submission tests the hypothesis that increasing the model's capacity will improve its generalizability and overall performance. The number of encoder layers is doubled from 2 to 4, and the embedding dimension is increased from 128 to 256.
